data.title: The Residences
data.about:
The Residence, Burj Khalifa, pays special attention to detail and provides facilities that are both intelligent and magnificent in order to reflect your passion’s ambitions. 

An elegantly built tower complex with 35 spectacular apartments ranging in size from 3 to 7 bedrooms. The magnificent Burj Khalifa and Fashion Avenue at Dubai Mall are only a few feet away. Unrivaled amenities surround you at every turn to ensure you enjoy the best life imaginable.
